baseline_orderings: neural, random, grammar-order, structural heuristic, validation oracle
candidate_enumerator: enumerate every gap action before gating; no verifier pruning in enumeration
candidate_grammar: even gap actions 2..256 plus overflow; gate rules reject impossible gaps
certificate_checker: algebraic certificate such as gcd(modulus, residue) > 1 proves rejected candidate is composite
claim_scope: certified next-prime action ranking and gate/proposer rows for configured split ranges
exact_verifier: segmented sieve returns the true next-prime gap and exact verifier work
gate_executor: accepted predicates reject impossible gaps before neural residual scoring
generalization_axis: train on smaller prime ranges; test on larger prime ranges and larger gap coverage
known_non_claims: does not claim primality proof beyond the sieve oracle or extrapolation outside configured limits
neural_scorer: shared MLP scores one state/action row and softmax ranks surviving candidates
observable_features: minimal default [log(p), normalized_gap, overflow_flag]; residue flags are disabled leakage ablations
outcome_row_schema: crlp.trace.v1 and crlp.compare.v1 rows keyed by stable action ids
proposer_inputs: structural rule descriptors only: kind, moduli, residues, reciprocal scales, zero indicators, gcd ratios
proposer_targets: budgeted marginal verifier utility labels; support and false-rejection counts are diagnostics, never inputs
replay_protocol: stable action-id JSONL traces train replay successors with parent checkpoint hashes
rl_protocol: supervised scorer, strict verifier policy gradient, and KL/entropy-regularized verifier policy gradient
role: compact arithmetic action-ranking benchmark for certified gate discovery
rule_grammar: modular rejection predicates over candidate residues and optional state-conditioned residues
state_distribution: deterministic prime stream split into train, validation, and held-out ranges
state_space: prime p below the task split limit
verifier_feedback: target gap, top-k correctness, ranking loss, exact probes, calibration bins

action_space: four moves: up, right, down, left
baseline_orderings: neural, random, grammar-order, structural heuristic, validation oracle
candidate_enumerator: enumerate all four moves, including blocked and out-of-bounds moves, before gating
candidate_grammar: four compass moves with legality and dominance gates
certificate_checker: finite validation/exhaustive geometry checks prove a rule never rejects an optimal move
claim_scope: shortest-path action ranking and certified move-pruning on generated 7x7 grids
exact_verifier: BFS identifies shortest-path successors and verifier node cost
gate_executor: accepted predicates remove impossible moves before neural scoring
generalization_axis: train on generated grids and test shifted obstacle densities, start/goal distances, and grid seeds
grounding_operator: BFS shortest-path oracle over the generated obstacle grid
known_non_claims: does not claim optimal planning beyond the generated finite grid family or undisclosed obstacle models
neural_scorer: shared MLP scores one grid/action row and softmax ranks surviving moves
observable_features: start/goal coordinates, candidate displacement, obstacle map, action one-hot, and Manhattan structural priors
outcome_row_schema: crlp.trace.v1 and crlp.rule_search.summary.v1 rows keyed by stable move ids
proposer_inputs: structural rule descriptors: rule kind, direction, boundary relation, cell relation, topology relation, admissible-bound relation, and exact-distance relation
proposer_targets: train/validation residual marginal utility under a certified rule budget
replay_protocol: stable action-id JSONL traces train replay successors with parent checkpoint hashes
rl_protocol: supervised scorer, strict verifier policy gradient, and KL/entropy-regularized verifier policy gradient
role: spatial shortest-path action-ranking benchmark for certified pruning outside arithmetic
rule_grammar: legality, dead-end, component-trap, clear-path admissible-bound, and shortest-distance dominance predicates over grid actions
state_distribution: deterministic grid generator split by train, validation, and held-out seed ranges
state_space: 7x7 obstacle grid with start and goal coordinates
verifier_feedback: target move, correctness, utility, candidate count, BFS nodes, calibration bins

baseline_orderings: neural, closed-loop residual, random, grammar-order, structural heuristic, validation oracle
candidate_enumerator: enumerate all four actions for every claim state
candidate_grammar: four fixed claim actions with threshold and risk-margin rejection predicates
certificate_checker: finite-generator safety check rejects rules that remove optimal actions on train+validation support
claim_scope: finite generated delayed-feedback action ranking under declared seed bands
exact_verifier: deterministic hidden rule computes action utilities and the best action
gate_executor: accepted predicates remove certified-unsafe actions before neural residual scoring
generalization_axis: train on one seed band and evaluate shifted seed bands plus harder uncertainty bands
known_non_claims: does not claim behavior for real-world claim adjudication or unobserved hidden-rule families
neural_scorer: shared MLP scores one claim/action row and softmax ranks actions
observable_features: observable claim features plus action one-hot; hidden outcome and utilities are excluded
outcome_row_schema: crlp.trace.v1 replay rows plus delayed-claim evaluation summaries
proposer_inputs: structural predicate descriptors: rule kind, feature index, threshold/margin bucket, action id, optional other-action id, polarity
proposer_targets: empirical support, marginal support, and false-rejection diagnostics from verifier labels
replay_protocol: stable action-id JSONL traces train replay successors with soft and hard target weights
rl_protocol: supervised scorer, strict verifier policy gradient, and KL/entropy-regularized verifier policy gradient
role: finite delayed-feedback decision task for trace replay and verifier-RL calibration
rule_grammar: threshold predicates plus direct utility-margin and indirect risk-margin predicates over trust/request actions
state_distribution: fixed train/test seed ranges over the same hidden-rule generator
state_space: six observable claim/evidence features generated from a deterministic simulator
verifier_feedback: target action, utility, proposal steps, calibration bins, replay loss

action_space: nine discrete player-input actions: NONE, W, A, D, S, WA, WD, SA, SD
baseline_orderings: goal-heading no-safety WASD baseline, uniform random, teacher trace action distribution, and raw neural scorer
candidate_enumerator: enumerate every WASD key combination supported by the first trace-brain interface
candidate_grammar: nine WASD key combinations plus rollout-time control-target hypotheses
certificate_checker: deterministic simulator replay that records collision pain, plus rollout-time control-target certificates over nav segment clearance, forward/velocity clearance, and progress alignment
claim_scope: offline and shadow replay rows for the declared Signal flight interface
exact_verifier: deterministic Signal authoritative replay for each WASD hypothesis; legacy teacher traces remain accepted for ablation
gate_executor: closed-loop rollout uses certified_control_target_v1 before neural WASD ranking; live active neural gate remains staged behind shadow/replay checks
generalization_axis: train simulator seeds to held-out simulator seeds with identical ship-control interface
grounding_operator: authoritative Signal simulator replay from captured deterministic states
known_non_claims: does not claim live active control unless live-active summaries report neural intervention
neural_scorer: tiny MLP scores one state/action row and softmax ranks WASD candidates
observable_features: candidate key controls plus normalized ship kinematics, heading, path, hull, and clearance observations
proposer_inputs: observable state/action rows only; no candidate-mask bit or teacher action is a scorer feature
proposer_targets: argmax over certified counterfactual utility rows that reward nose-forward progress; deterministic teacher imitation remains an explicit legacy ablation
replay_protocol: CSV trace replay with stable action ids matching Signal brain.c WASD ordering
rl_protocol: counterfactual replay from deterministic simulator states plus closed-loop certified-control-target rollouts for residual failure mining
role: Signal headless simulator trace reduced to WASD action scoring
rule_grammar: WASD control hypotheses plus rollout-time direct/nav/bypass/brake control-target hypotheses; richer flight predicates planned
state_distribution: episodes generated by ../signal/build/flight_trace from deterministic simulator seeds
state_space: ship pose, velocity, hull, path, local clearance sensors, and target/control-point geometry
verifier_feedback: certified utility, straight-forward progress, wall-aware clearance, hull loss, damage/death events, held-out top-k regret, NLL, calibration, and candidate-mask sanity rate

action_space: fourteen bounded policy hypotheses generated from a grammar over target rule, route constraint, speed/contact profile, and interaction primitive; each compiles to legal player controls
baseline_orderings: fixed grammar baseline: slow repair when damaged, refinery lane when towing, slow fragment collection when visible, otherwise nearest-clear-rock cruise
candidate_enumerator: enumerate the bounded policy grammar for every sampled state; each hypothesis owns a deterministic controller for the replay horizon
candidate_grammar: target selector x route constraint x speed/contact profile x interaction primitive
certificate_checker: authoritative replay records candidate outcomes; verifier outputs are labels/diagnostics and are not scorer inputs
claim_scope: offline tactical option ranking over the declared deterministic Signal mining scenarios
exact_verifier: fresh deterministic Signal simulator replay from the same scenario seed and prefix for each candidate option
gate_executor: candidate policies drive normal Signal input_intent_t controls through world_sim_step; no sim state is shallow-copied
generalization_axis: train deterministic world seeds to held-out deterministic world seeds, economy prefixes, and supply-chain starts
grounding_operator: authoritative Signal world replay over deterministic tactical option prefixes
known_non_claims: does not claim live economy control or scenario families outside the replay-certified prefixes
neural_scorer: tiny MLP scores one tactical option row and softmax ranks options within a replay group
observable_features: candidate hypothesis id, grammar primitive one-hots, base option id, plus observable ship, rock, fragment, station, demand, and prefix-state features
proposer_inputs: observable state/action features only; replay utility and event counters are targets
replay_protocol: JSONL counterfactual groups with stable tactical option ids and identical deterministic scenario prefixes
rl_protocol: offline simulator replay ranking; later live shadow rows can append the same option ids
role: Signal tactical mining and supply-chain hypothesis ranker over simulator-certified candidates
rule_grammar: target selector x route constraint x speed/contact profile x interaction primitive; neural scorer ranks only replay-certified grammar hypotheses
state_distribution: deterministic Signal world seeds with station starts, rock approaches, autopilot-generated mining prefixes, and live NPC economy prefixes
state_space: authoritative Signal world state after deterministic scenario prefix: ship hull/kinematics, towed fragments, nearby rocks, fragments, docks, refinery demand, shipyard inputs, and repair-kit stock
verifier_feedback: certified utility, smelts, pickups, fractures, mining ticks, towed fragments, shipyard-input deltas, repair-kit deltas, hull loss, damage events, and death events
